T1.implementation_approach: Install necessary tools (e.g., IDE, version control, package managers), initialize version control (e.g., Git), and configure project structure.
T1.notes: Ensure all team members have the same environment setup.

T2.implementation_approach: Identify entities and relationships, create an ER diagram, and translate it into a normalized relational schema.

T3.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle CRUD operations for problems, using a framework like Django or Express.js.
T3.notes: Ensure proper validation and error handling.

T4.implementation_approach: Use a frontend framework like React or Angular to create a user interface for browsing and searching problems.
T4.notes: Focus on responsive design and user experience.

T5.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to handle code submissions, execute code in a sandboxed environment, and return results.
T5.notes: Ensure security and prevent malicious code execution.

T6.implementation_approach: Create a user interface for submitting code and displaying results using a frontend framework.
T6.notes: Provide real-time feedback and progress indicators.

T7.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to calculate and retrieve leaderboard rankings based on user performance.

T8.implementation_approach: Create a user interface to display leaderboard rankings with sorting and filtering options.
T8.notes: Ensure rankings are visually appealing and easy to navigate.

T9.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to manage tutorials and guides, including CRUD operations.
T9.notes: Support multimedia content like images and videos.

T10.implementation_approach: Create a user interface for browsing and viewing tutorials and guides.
T10.notes: Ensure content is easy to read and navigate.

T11.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to manage user profiles, including authentication, profile updates, and activity tracking.
T11.notes: Ensure secure handling of user data.

T12.implementation_approach: Create a user interface for viewing and editing user profiles.
T12.notes: Provide a user-friendly and customizable profile page.

T13.implementation_approach: Write unit tests for individual components and functions using a testing framework.

T14.implementation_approach: Perform integration testing to ensure different modules work together as expected.
T14.notes: Test edge cases and error handling.

T15.implementation_approach: Set up CI/CD pipelines, configure servers, and deploy the application to a cloud platform.

from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy

# Initialize the SQLAlchemy object
db = SQLAlchemy()

from app.database import db

class Problem(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'problems'

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    title = db.Column(db.String(255), nullable=False)
    description = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False)
    difficulty = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=db.func.now())
    updated_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=db.func.now(), onupdate=db.func.now())

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"<Problem {self.title} (ID: {self.id})>"

from app.database import db

class User(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'users'

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    username = db.Column(db.String(80), unique=True, nullable=False)
    email = db.Column(db.String(120), unique=True, nullable=False)
    password_hash = db.Column(db.String(128), nullable=False)
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, nullable=False, server_default=db.func.now())
    updated_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, nullable=False, server_default=db.func.now(), onupdate=db.func.now())

    def __repr__(self):
        return f'<User {self.username}>'

from app.database import db

class Solution(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'solutions'

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    user_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('users.id'), nullable=False)
    problem_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('problems.id'), nullable=False)
    code = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False)
    language = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=False)
    result = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=True)
    submitted_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=db.func.now(), nullable=False)

    user = db.relationship('User', back_populates='solutions')
    problem = db.relationship('Problem', back_populates='solutions')

    def __repr__(self):
        return f'<Solution id={self.id}, user_id={self.user_id}, problem_id={self.problem_id}, result={self.result}>'

from flask import Blueprint
from app.controllers.problem_controller import problem_blueprint
from app.controllers.user_controller import user_blueprint
from app.controllers.solution_controller import solution_blueprint

# Main Blueprint for aggregating all the blueprints
main_blueprint = Blueprint('main', __name__)

# Registering all blueprints
main_blueprint.register_blueprint(problem_blueprint, url_prefix='/problems')
main_blueprint.register_blueprint(user_blueprint, url_prefix='/users')
main_blueprint.register_blueprint(solution_blueprint, url_prefix='/solutions')

from flask import Flask
from app.database import db
from app.routes import problem_blueprint, user_blueprint, solution_blueprint

def create_app():
    app = Flask(__name__)

    # Configure the app
    app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = 'sqlite:///app.db'
    app.config['SQLALCHEMY_TRACK_MODIFICATIONS'] = False

    # Initialize database
    db.init_app(app)

    # Register blueprints
    app.register_blueprint(problem_blueprint)
    app.register_blueprint(user_blueprint)
    app.register_blueprint(solution_blueprint)

    return app

from app import create_app

# Entry point for the ACM Problem-Solving Platform application
app = create_app()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run()

# ACM Problem-Solving Platform

A website designed to help users solve ACM programming problems efficiently.

## Features

- Problem Repository: A comprehensive collection of ACM programming problems categorized by difficulty and topic.
- Code Submission System: Allows users to submit their code and receive instant feedback on correctness and performance.
- Leaderboard: Displays rankings of users based on their problem-solving performance and activity.
- Tutorials and Guides: Provides educational resources to help users understand algorithms and problem-solving techniques.
- User Profiles: Allows users to create profiles to track their progress and achievements.

## Setup

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py
```

## Usage

Open http://localhost:5000 in your browser.
